The one epoch-advance with money in it, EarlyExitModule.settleEpoch(), is onlyBorrower (reverts Unauthorized from a fresh address). One EOA keeper already runs it ~every 5 h for nothing, so there is no unclaimed reward stream, and no reward token exists (docs: returns come from credit margins, not token incentives). Consistent with the avalanche instance (attempts:1699, unpaid).
